title: M3Hop-CoT: Misogynous Meme Identification with Multimodal Multi-hop Chain-of-Thought
benchmark_measurement: Stereotype detection and contextual understanding in religious contexts as part of a broader misogyny identification task.
findings: The proposed M3Hop-CoT model successfully leverages cultural knowledge, including historical Christian beliefs and biblical interpretations, to correctly identify misogynistic connotations in memes where baseline models fail. This demonstrates its superior ability to understand nuanced religious and cultural contexts.
